subject: Request to preserve pilot while finance verifies funding
content:
From: Amina Qureshi <amina@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Lee <marco@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — funding verification delay

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side: our procurement team needs an extra week to confirm the wire for the pilot. Legal and security are already signed off, but finance flagged a vendor validation step that pushed the approval out. We rely on the sandbox for an internal demo scheduled next Tuesday — if access lapses it would derail a customer-facing presentation.

Can Redwood extend the pilot access or provide a short-term credit so our engineers can keep the demo work live while finance completes the validation? We expect the wire to clear by 8/27.

Appreciate any help here.

Thanks,
Amina Qureshi
Head of Innovation
ClearPath Health

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Amina Qureshi <amina@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — funding verification delay

Hi Amina — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the expected timeline.

We can keep the pilot active while finance completes the vendor validation. I can approve a 7-day temporary credit to cover your demo next Tuesday — that should preserve the environment without interrupting your work. To move forward I need two quick confirmations:

- Confirm the internal demo date/time (so we set usage windows).
- Confirm the wire ETA (you mentioned 8/27).

Ben, Vanessa — please confirm from finance/ops if a 7-day, capped credit is OK for DEAL-7629 and I will send the credit agreement.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — funding verification delay

Evelyn — finance is OK with a small, time-boxed bridge as long as we attach a short terms sheet and cap the spend to $1,000. Please include:
- Deal ID DEAL-7629
- Credit: $1,000 max or 7 calendar days (whichever comes first)
- Auto-revocation once the wire is confirmed / PO received

Vanessa, can you prepare the term sheet and a DocuSign for Amina? If they need a purchase order reference, Marco will share that once available.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amina Qureshi <amina@clearpathhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — funding verification delay

Amina — attaching a short terms sheet that documents the temporary credit. Key points: capped at $1,000, valid for 7 days from 8/27/2027, automatic removal of credit once PO or payment confirmation is received.

Attachment: temporary_credits_term-sheet.pdf (1 page — signature required)

Next steps for ClearPath:
1) Reply with the confirmed demo date/time.
2) Sign the attached term sheet (DocuSign link will follow from our legal operations).
3) Share PO or wire confirmation once available so we can reconcile and remove the provisional credit.

If anything about the cap or duration needs to change, flag it here and we can review. Otherwise I will trigger the DocuSign and enable the credit on 8/27 morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo going smoothly.

Warmly,
Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

---
From: Amina Qureshi <amina@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — funding verification delay

Thank you — this is perfect. Demo is scheduled for Tue 8/31 at 10:00 AM PT. I will sign the term sheet as soon as the DocuSign arrives and will ping Marco to expedite the PO reference. Really appreciate the quick help from the team.

Best,
Amina
